mapper.select: SELECT _nextIndex(#{sequenceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
select corb.REGIST_BANK_CODE from CHB_ORG_REGIST_BANK_CODE corb where corb.ORG_CODE = #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select SI.INSTITUTION_NAME from SYS_INSTITUTION si where si.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select CORB.*,SI.INSTITUTION_NAME belongInstitutionName from CHB_ORG_REGIST_BANK_CODE corb LEFT JOIN SYS_INSTITUTION SI ON CORB.ORG_CODE = SI.INSTITUTION_CODE where 1=1
and corb.ORG_CODE = #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT DEPT_CODE FROM SYS_DEPARTMENT WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}

SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE as institutionCode, DEPT_CODE as deptCode, SUM(ROLE_DATA_TYPE) as roleDataType FROM SYS_DATA_ROLE_MODULE WHERE ROLE_ID IN (SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SYS_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND ROLE_DATA_TYPE IN ('02', '04') GROUP BY INSTITUTION_CODE, DEPT_CODE
SELECT ITEM_VALUE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST WHERE DICT_CODE = #{dictCode} and ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode}
SELECT DICT_CODE, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_VALUE, ORDER_NO, DEFAULT_VALUE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST WHERE DICT_CODE = #{dictCode}
SELECT ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST WHERE DICT_CODE = #{dictCode} and ITEM_VALUE = #{itemValue}

select PARAM_VALUE from SYS_PARA where PARA_CODE =#{paramCode}
and SYSTEM_CODE = #{systemCode}

SELECT TRIM(ITEM_CODE) AS itemCode, TRIM(LINKED_ITEM_CODE) AS linkedItemCode FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK WHERE DICT_CODE = 'INSTITUTION_INDUSTRY_SECOND_LEVEL' AND LINKED_DICT_CODE = 'INSTITUTION_INDUSTRY_FIRST_LEVEL'
SELECT INSTITUTION_TYPE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}
SELECT INSTITUTION_TYPE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION where institution = #{institutionCode}

SELECT INSTITUTION_TYPE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION SI WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_DEPARTMENT SD WHERE SD.INSTITUTION_CODE = SI.INSTITUTION_CODE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER SU WHERE SD.DEPT_CODE = SU.DEPT_CODE AND SU.USER_NAME = #{userName} ))

SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION SI WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_DEPARTMENT SD WHERE SD.INSTITUTION_CODE = SI.INSTITUTION_CODE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER SU WHERE SD.DEPT_CODE = SU.DEPT_CODE AND SU.USER_NAME = #{userName} ))

SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE FROM ( SELECT si.INSTITUTION_CODE, si.UPPER_INSTITUTION_CODE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION si WHERE si.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{ institutionCode } UNION ALL SELECT si2.INSTITUTION_CODE,si2.UPPER_INSTITUTION_CODE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION si2, TEMP_INSTITUTION b WHERE b.UPPER_INSTITUTION_CODE = si2.INSTITUTION_CODE )TEMP_INSTITUTION
SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE FROM SYS_INSTITUTION SI WHERE INSTITUTION_TYPE = '01'
SELECT (begin_num + incr) FROM SYS_SEQUENCE WHERE `name` = #{sequenceName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT incr FROM SYS_SEQUENCE WHERE `name` = #{sequenceName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE SYS_SEQUENCE SET begin_num = ((#{incrNum,jdbcType=INTEGER} * incr) + begin_num) WHERE `name` = #{sequenceName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
